svg.title: Vocal and spatial roles
svg.desc: Clean, scream and growl feed VMR on LEAD VOCAL BUS; backing L/R feed VMR on BACKING VOCAL BUS. Both feed VOCAL BUS and then MIX BUS. Individual Mantra and VOCALITH modules are selected by vocal style and passage. ContextVerb ROOM/HALL return to MUSIC BUS; PLATE and H3000 delays return to MIX BUS.
